definition: normal clothings (as diff. from the official uniform as of policemen, military men, etc.).
example: ರಜೆಯ ದಿನ ಅವನು ಬೇದಿರ್ಸು ಧರಿಸಿ ಹೊರಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: On the holiday, he went outside wearing normal clothes.

definition: the hollowed palm (as to hold something).
example_en: He filled his hollowed palm with rice.

definition: something written in code or cipher; cryptogram.
example_en: The message was written in cryptogram.

definition: warmed; heated.
example_en: His body became heated from walking in the sun.

definition: to carry on a trade or business; to trade.
example_en: He carried on the grain trade.

definition: heaviness as a quality of things; weight.
example_en: The weight of the bundle was too much to carry.

definition: to be utterly confused, bewildered or perplexed.
example_en: He became utterly confused by the sudden question.

definition: a plant producing more than one kind of spore, esp. producing microspores and megaspores.
example_en: Biologists study heterosporous plants.

definition: the back part of the human foot, under the ankle and behind the instep; the heel.
example_en: The sandal bit into her heel and it turned red.

definition: the sun.
example_en: The sun's rays fell upon the hill.

definition: a prodding with a pointed stick to urge a cattle.
example: ಎತ್ತು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರಲು ರೈತ ಅದರ ಬೆನ್ನಿಗೆ ಮುಳುಹು ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: As the ox was walking slowly, the farmer gave it a prod with a pointed stick on its back.

definition: a harvested field.
example_en: They let the cattle graze in the harvested field.

definition: the act of murmuring, muttering complaints; a grumbling.
example_en: The people's grumbling was heard loudly in the meeting.

definition: to shield from injury, danger or loss; to guard; to defend; to protect.
example_en: The soldiers protected the border from enemies.

definition: the black metal; iron.
example_en: The blacksmith made a sword from iron.

definition: to make a signal or signals to; to signal.
example_en: The policeman signalled the vehicles to stop.

definition: too much or too great.
example_en: He felt too great a joy.

definition: a foot which has a hard, thick, painful growth of skin; a corn-foot.
example: ಟೈಟ್ ಶೂ ಧರಿಸಿದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅಯ್ರುಗಾಲು ಬಂದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: He had developed a painful corn on his foot from wearing tight shoes.

definition: following, occurring or coming as per the order, sequence; not breaking the established arrangement.
example_en: The programme's activities took place in proper sequence.

definition: temporary loss of one's bodily awareness, resulting from rapture, melody, tiredness, etc.; the state of being stupefied.
example_en: Because of tiredness, he felt a stupor come over him.

definition: a stupid fellow.
example_en: That stupid fellow stood not understanding anything.

definition: a meditating on (something) deeply; deep continued thought; meditation.
example: ಸಾಧು ದೇವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ದ್ಯಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The ascetic was immersed in deep meditation on God.

definition: foolish behaviour, act or idea; foolishness.
example_en: Everyone laughed seeing his foolishness.

definition: to rub or pass over gently with the palm with affection or to alleviate pain, distress, etc.
example_en: The mother gently stroked the child's head with affection.

definition: the duty, office or state of a servant.
example_en: He carried out his duty as a servant honestly.

definition: over or across the sea; overseas.
example: ಆ ಸಾಗರೋತ್ತರ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ದೇಶದ ಆದಾಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That overseas trade increased the country's income.

definition: to wear (a dress ornament, etc.).
example_en: She wore the gold ornament on her body.

definition: immodest, shameless speech.
example_en: The assembly was startled to hear his shameless speech.

definition: a state of mental distress; worry.
example_en: That family suffered great distress due to poverty.

definition: a tender coconut.
example_en: The tender coconut is very tasty in this town.

definition: (the muscles of the stomach) to draw in; to get drawn in.
example_en: His stomach drew in from hunger.

definition: the water that is evaporated.
example_en: In summer the evaporated water was lost into the air.

definition: the plant Paspalum scrobiculatum ( = P. fumentaceum) of Poaceae family.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಉದ್ದಾಲಕ ಗಿಡ ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The uddalaka plant grows abundantly in this region.

definition: (dial.) the fact or condition of being troubled, annoyed or irritated; annoyance, irritation.
example_en: She became irritated and annoyed because of his words.

definition: (dial.) a very hard working man.
example: ಆ ಕಷ್ಟಕಾರ ಬೆಳಗಿನಿಂದ ಸಂಜೆಯವರೆಗೆ ಗದ್ದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದುಡಿದನು.
example_en: That very hard-working man toiled in the field from morning till evening.

definition: any of various accipitrine birds (family: Accipitridae) having a characteristic curved beak, short, rounded wings and a long tail and legs; a hawk.
example_en: A hawk was flying about in the sky.

definition: to cut or sever completely.
example_en: The butcher severed the rope completely with one stroke.

definition: an unusual, unnatural (usu. intolerable) smell.
example_en: The intolerable, unusual smell coming from the drain was unbearable.

definition: a written acknowledgment that something, as goods, money, etc., has been received; a receipt.
example_en: The shopkeeper gave me a receipt.

definition: she who delights.
example_en: Nandini delights everyone's heart.

definition: the act of extending, stretching, spreading.
example_en: The vine's spreading extended along the whole wall.

definition: the water-goddess.
example_en: The fishermen offered flowers to the water-goddess.

definition: a person desirous of attaining salvation.
example: ಆ ಮುಮುಕ್ಷು ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ತಪಸ್ಸು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That seeker of salvation went to the forest and did penance.

definition: to arouse from sleep, stupor, etc.
example_en: The mother gently woke the child from sleep.

definition: a dilapidated, broken down, neglected or desolated house.
example_en: A dilapidated house stood at the edge of the town.

definition: a mountain (in gen.).
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಸುತ್ತ ಎತ್ತರವಾದ ಮಲಯ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a tall mountain around that town.

definition: a written or printed message sent to another person, persons, etc.; a letter.
example_en: He wrote a letter to his mother.

definition: the act of spreading, scattering or being spread, scattered over a wide area.
example_en: The spreading of the news happened quickly.

definition: a man who is separated from his beloved woman.
example_en: That man separated from his beloved wandered in the forest in sorrow.

definition: to cut into pieces; to separate by cutting, severing from a whole.
example: ಅಡುಗೆಯವಳು ತರಕಾರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೋಚಿಮಾಡು ಮಾಡಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆಗೆ ಹಾಕಿದಳು.
example_en: The cook cut the vegetables into pieces and put them in the pot.

definition: (collectively) parts that have been broken off, stripped off, etc., esp. leaves, twigs; trash; rubbish.
example_en: When the plant was pruned, the broken twigs and leaves lay scattered everywhere.

definition: a variety in goose.
example_en: The variety of goose was swimming in the pond.

definition: woollen cloth or blanket.
example_en: He slept wrapped in woollen cloth against the cold.

definition: a ray of light.
example_en: The sun's ray fell upon the hill.

definition: a man lacking natural courage; a timid man; a coward.
example_en: That coward ran away from the battle.

definition: a place for outdoor games and recreation; a play ground.
example_en: The children were playing at the playground in the evening.

definition: to agree to; to take to one's self.
example_en: He happily agreed to that suggestion.

definition: to learn reading and writing.
example_en: The child learned reading and writing at school.

definition: a branding on one's body with hot die having a mark of divine conch, circular missile etc. of Viṣṇu.
example_en: The elders used to have the devotees of God branded with the hot sacred mark.

definition: excessive indulgence of sexual desires; lechery; lewdness.
example_en: His lewdness caused strife in the family.

definition: the tree Syzygium zeylanicum (= S. spicata, = Eugenia zeylanica) of Myrtaceae family.
example_en: A nerkal tree had grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: a piece of furniture with a flat, square or rectangular wooden plank with four legs, to sit on.
example_en: The child sat on the stool and played.

definition: ho! ho! - a term used calling a woman.
example_en: Ho there, woman! Come here and bring water.

definition: amounting to ninety-six.
example: ಆ ಪಂದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಟಗಾರ ಸಾಣವ ಓಟಗಳನ್ನು ಗಳಿಸಿದ.
example_en: In that match, the player scored ninety-six runs.

definition: a forest; jungle; woods.
example: ರಾಜನ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಪಳವುವಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಗಿ ಗಡಿ ತಲುಪಿತು.
example_en: The king's army passed through the forest and reached the border.

definition: not moving; stationary.
example_en: This pedestal has been kept stationary.

definition: a god; a deity.
example_en: People came to the temple to worship the god.

definition: to confine within bounds; to set a limit to; to restrict or curb; to limit.
example_en: The officials restricted the growth of the city.

definition: a blow from one side.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹಿಂದಿನಿಂದ ಬಂದ ಅಡ್ಡಹೊಯ್ ತಟ್ಟನೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A sudden blow from one side struck him from behind.

definition: an explanation or justification of an act, idea, etc.; a reason.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ತಡವಾಗಿ ಬಂದುದಕ್ಕೆ ಅಪದೇಶ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He gave a reason for coming late.

definition: a frantic, frenzied man.
example_en: That frantic man ran about in the street shouting.

definition: the medium to large sized, evergreen tree Azadirachta indica ( = Melia azadirachta) of Meliaceae family.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಬೇವು ಮರ ಹೆಮ್ಮರವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: The neem tree has grown large in front of the house.

definition: the affairs of a state or nation and managing them.
example_en: The ministers are engaged in the affairs of the state.

definition: not invaded; not occupied; unassailed.
example_en: That region is still in an unoccupied state.

definition: the art or occupation of a potter; ceramics; pottery.
example_en: He has been practicing pottery for generations.

definition: a variety in mango trees.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ಗೇರಮಾವು ಮರವನ್ನು ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ನೆಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: Grandfather planted a Geramavu mango tree in front of the house.

definition: a man needing food; a hungry man.
example_en: Food was given to that hungry man.

definition: a building or a room in it, where arrangements are made for the stay of a guest or guests; a temporary guest house.
example_en: We stayed one night at the village's temporary guest house.

definition: the underground reserve of oil; oil-reserve.
example_en: A large oil-reserve was discovered in that region.

definition: to labour; to endeavour.
example_en: He laboured hard to prepare for the exam.

definition: a white, metallic chemical element that is extremely ductile and malleable, capable of a high polish, and the best metal conductor of heat and electricity, symbol Ag; silver.
example_en: That ornament is made of pure silver.

definition: (used reflexively) that or those belonging to oneself.
example_en: This is his own book, not someone else's.

definition: to thrash heavily (as to cause the death of that person).
example_en: In the fight he thrashed his opponent heavily.

definition: a boy.
example: ಆ ಹಯ್ದ ಗುರುಗಳ ಬಳಿ ಪಾಠ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That boy was learning lessons near the teacher.

definition: that cannot be dissolved; indissoluble.
example_en: Their friendship was an indissoluble bond.

definition: a binding of oneself to.
example_en: He bound himself to that vow.

definition: a female organiser or manager.
example_en: She works as the female manager of the company.

definition: something asked, requested or solicited for.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಬೇಡಿದುಗಳನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: He listed and wrote down all the things he had requested for.

definition: to feel anguish; to undergo mental agony.
example: ಮಗನ ಅಪಘಾತದ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ತಾಯಿ ಎದೆಗುದಿಗೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: On hearing the news of her son's accident, the mother felt anguish.

definition: the act of arranging in an orderly way; organisation.
example_en: The organisation of this event was very laborious.

definition: hair growing on the scalp.
example_en: His scalp hair had turned grey.

definition: a man engaged in, busy or occupied with.
example_en: That busy man was engrossed in his work.

definition: a flat piece of wood or similar material, often rectangular, for some special use; a board.
example_en: The teacher wrote on the board.

definition: to follow, come in, form a line.
example_en: People waited in a line for the bus.

definition: a pair of small, hollowed pieces of wood or ivory held in the hand by a connecting cord clicked together with the fingers to beat time to music; castanets.
example_en: The dancer began to dance, playing the castanets.

definition: to leap or jump up or forward.
example_en: The horse leaped over the fence.

definition: fear; fright; scare; alarm; panic.
example_en: Hearing the thunder, the child felt fright.

definition: manual or unskilled labour done for (usu. little) pay paid on daily basis.
example_en: Poor labourers feed themselves with their daily wage labour.

definition: facing one; (keeping, positioning) against; in front of.
example: ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ ನನ್ನ ಮನೆಯ ಎದುರಿಗೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The bus stop is in front of my house.

definition: other than usual, referred to or mentioned already.
example_en: Let us discuss the other matters mentioned already tomorrow.

definition: excessiveness of quantity, triumph or excellence.
example: ಆ ವರ್ಷ ಸುಗ್ಗಿಯ ಉಬ್ಬಟೆ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೆರಗುಗೊಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That year the excessive abundance of the harvest amazed everyone.

definition: put forth young leaves; given off shoots or buds; sprouted; germinated.
example_en: After the rain, the mango tree put forth young leaves.

definition: the lateral rafter that supports the ridge-piece of a roof.
example_en: Because the lateral rafter was tied firmly, the roof became stable.

definition: that which is broken, shattered.
example_en: That vessel has now become broken.

definition: having enough power, skill, etc. to do something; able.
example: ಅವನು ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವುದರಲ್ಲಿ ರುಸ್ತುಂ ಆಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: He is capable of doing this work.

definition: any of the many small, solid bodies travelling through outer space, which are seen as meteors when they enter the earth's atmosphere; a meteoroid (falling of which on the earth is believed to bring ill-fortune to the country).
example: ಉತ್ಪಾತಕೇತು ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಗಿ ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಅಮಂಗಳವನ್ನು ತರುವುದೆಂದು ನಂಬುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People believe that a meteoroid blazing in the sky brings ill-fortune to the country.

definition: the quality of being shameless, impudent; shamelessness; effrontery; impudence.
example_en: Everyone grew angry at his shamelessness.

definition: an attempt or effort; a try.
example_en: His effort to solve the problem succeeded.

definition: any delicious fruit.
example_en: The grandmother brought a delicious fruit for her grandson.

definition: to copy or follow (something) as it is.
example_en: He wrote by copying the teacher's writing exactly.

definition: the condition of being unstable or unsteady.
example_en: Instability was seen in the new government's policy.

definition: to console with kind solacing words.
example_en: She consoled the sorrowful child with kind words.

definition: to be charmed greatly; to enchanted.
example_en: Seeing the beauty of the picture, the viewers become greatly enchanted.

definition: giving warmth (against cold).
example_en: A warm blanket is needed in winter.

definition: the tree Premna longifolia of Verbenaceae family.
example_en: Medicine is prepared from the leaves of the gaṇigārike tree.

definition: an elder brother.
example_en: The elder brother gave good advice to his younger brother.

definition: an opposing or confronting bravely and defiantly.
example_en: A bold confrontation took place between the two warriors.

definition: a kind of punishment.
example_en: The offender was given that kind of punishment.

definition: an excellent one among ascetics.
example: ಆ ಮುನಿಯನ್ನು ಜತಿರಾಯ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಗೌರವಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People honoured that sage as the excellent one among ascetics.

definition: the quality or condition of being white; whiteness.
example_en: The whiteness of the snow covered the entire mountain.

definition: to be bitter or irritating to the taste; to be acrid.
example_en: This leafy vegetable tastes bitter in the mouth.

definition: calmed; composed.
example_en: His mind became calmed by the teacher's words.

definition: to stumble and fall down.
example_en: He stumbled on a stone and fell down.

definition: (a porcupine) to erect the spines (from fear, anger, etc.).
example_en: The frightened porcupine erected its spines.

definition: the act of eating.
example_en: The hungry lion's act of eating finished quickly.

definition: a brave fighter.
example_en: The brave fighter charged forward on the battlefield.

definition: to catch up something (that is going or progressing ahead) and go or progress beyond.
example_en: The horse overtook everyone and ran ahead.

definition: the large-sized, evergreen tree Palaquium ellipticum ( = Dichopsis elliptica) of Sapotaceae family.
example_en: The Palaquium ellipticum tree grows in the dense forest.

definition: the black bumble-bee.
example_en: A bumble-bee buzzed and roamed about in the flower garden.

definition: a man who receives payment or money or something that is due to him (from others).
example_en: The creditor asked for the money that was due to him.

definition: the quality of being bold, courageous; bravery; fearlessness.
example_en: The soldier's fearlessness was an example to everyone.

definition: a pedal used by weavers for separating the shuttles from each other.
example_en: The weaver pressed the pedal with his foot.

definition: to push forward.
example_en: He pushed the cart forward.

definition: the Supreme Being transcending all possible attributes; the Absolute.
example_en: The sages became absorbed in meditation on the Supreme Being.

definition: a picture - a) an image or likeness of an object, person or scene produced on a flat surface, by painting, drawing; b) a printed reproduction of this; c) an image or picture made by photography.
example_en: They have drawn a beautiful picture on the wall.

definition: a Muslim year.
example: ಫಸಲಿ ವರ್ಷದ ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರವನ್ನು ಹಳೆಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು.
example_en: The reckoning of the Muslim fasli year can be found in old records.

definition: the beginning of the night; the onset of darkness; the period of the day following sunset.
example_en: He reached home at the onset of darkness.

definition: (one's) left side.
example_en: He turned to his left side and walked.

definition: a kind of potherb.
example_en: The chakravarta greens are available in the market.

definition: a tooth used for grinding; a molar tooth.
example_en: His molar tooth cracked and caused pain.

definition: a vertical fold of a dhōti (a long loincloth worn by many men in India) or sīre (a garment worn by Hindu women, consisting of a long piece of cotton or silk wrapped around the body with one end draped over the head or over one shoulder).
example_en: She carefully arranged the folds of her saree.

definition: a standing together.
example_en: That king's kingdom was vast.

definition: of, given to or engaged in study; characterised by close attention; thoughtful; studious.
example: ಆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಅನೂಚಾನನಾಗಿ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That student studied the texts in a studious manner.

definition: milk into which powdered almond and sugar are added.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಮಲಗುವ ಮುನ್ನ ನಾನು ಬಾದಾಮಿಹಾಲು ಕುಡಿಯುತ್ತೇನೆ.
example_en: I drink almond milk before going to sleep at night.

definition: mentally disturbed, agitated, perturbed.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಮುಮ್ಮುಳಿತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that news, her mind became agitated.

definition: sour butter-milk.
example_en: Drinking sour butter-milk is good in summer.

definition: a man of noble birth.
example_en: He was a man of noble birth from a noble family.

definition: one of the yogic veins in the human body.
example_en: Yogis channel the life force through the pusha vein.

definition: the state of being dual; duality.
example: ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಸ್ವಭಾವದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಗುಣಗಳ ಉಭಯತ್ವ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a duality of good and bad qualities in human nature.

definition: excessive frequency and looseness of bowel movements; diarrhoea.
example_en: He took medicine because he had diarrhoea.

definition: a very fine silk cloth.
example_en: She wore a fine silk sari for the wedding.

definition: a class of persons engaged in earth-work as digging tanks, building roads, etc.
example: ಮಣ್ಣೊಡ್ಡ ಜನರು ಕೆರೆ ತೋಡುವ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The earth-workers did the work of digging the tank.

definition: to give a massage to; to massage.
example_en: She massaged the baby's legs.

definition: a forked branch of a tree.
example: ಆ ಮರದ ಇರ್ಕವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಗೂಡು ಕಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A bird had built its nest in the fork of that tree.

definition: the condensation formed, usu. during night, on lawns, cars, etc. as a result of relatively warm air contacting a cool surface; dew.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾವ ಇರ್ಪನಿ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಹನಿಗೂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In the early morning, dew had gathered on the leaves.

definition: the act of cooperating secretly (with someone), esp. in wrongdoing; connivance.
example: ಆ ಮೋಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಷರೀಕು ಇತ್ತು ಎಂಬುದು ಬಯಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It was revealed that he had connived in that fraud.

definition: (pros.) a foot of two syllables, a long one followed by a short one; trochee.
example: ಈ ಪದ್ಯದ ಪಾದವು ಗಲ ಎಂಬ ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿದೆ.
example_en: This verse's foot is composed in the trochee metre.

definition: a thing, matter to be dealt with at a meating, usu. listed in an agenda; one of the items listed to be done.
example_en: The agenda items of the meeting were discussed one by one.

definition: a consistent orderly or pleasing arrangement of parts or members; congruity; harmony.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಳಯ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was harmony among all the parts of that house.

definition: a barrier as of wooden or metal wires etc. or of thorny plants, along with the boundary of a town.
example: ಊರ ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಊರ್ವೇಲಿಯನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They built a barrier around the town and protected it.

definition: to wash with water.
example_en: She washed the pots with water.

definition: a ball to be played with, by throwing.
example_en: The children were playing with a throwing ball in the street.

definition: a leasing out or taking on lease an extent of land on an agreed rate or amount of tax.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಆ ಜಮೀನನ್ನು ಕಾಯಂಗುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The government gave that land on a fixed-rate lease.

definition: relating to the magical art; deceptive; illusive; magical.
example_en: The audience was spellbound by the magical scenes.

definition: to move, lift, etc. with or as with a lever.
example_en: He lifted the stone with a stick as a lever.

definition: being crooked; not straight; serpentine.
example_en: The winding crookedness of that path made walking difficult.

definition: a bright, sparkling light; glitter; flash of light.
example_en: The glitter of the jewellery was visible even from afar.

definition: a living together hormoniously without hostility.
example_en: Because of the harmonious living of the neighbours, peace settled in the town.

definition: a ruler; a king.
example_en: That king ruled his subjects with love.

definition: a short story meant to teach a moral lesson; a fable.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ನೀತಿಕಥೆ ಹೇಳಿ ಪಾಠ ಕಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher taught the children a lesson by telling them a fable.

definition: the act of opposing; opposition.
example_en: The villagers' opposition to the project was strong.

definition: to use a hoe; to start digging the earth.
example_en: The farmer used a hoe in the field and sowed the seeds.

definition: the prescribed political, moral and ethical ways for ruling a state or nation.
example_en: The king ruled the kingdom according to political and moral principles.

definition: the act of seeing or being seen.
example_en: They had come from far to get a sight of the swamiji.

definition: the red colour.
example_en: The red colour of that gem shone in the ornament.

definition: affliction of the body; pain or trouble in the body.
example_en: As he grew old, his bodily affliction increased.

definition: the act of one who whispers; whispering, esp. maligning a third person.
example: ಅವನ ಉಪಜಾಹದಿಂದ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ನಡುವೆ ಜಗಳ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Because of his whispering slander, a quarrel arose between the two friends.

definition: an obstacle raised or kept at the place where two roads intersect.
example_en: The police set up a barricade at the road junction.

definition: the act of breaking, shattering (into pieces).
example_en: A split occurred between the two factions.

definition: the yeast foam that appears on the surface of malt liquors as they ferment; barm.
example: ಮದ್ಯ ಕುದಿಯುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗ ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾರೋತ್ತರ ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: While the liquor was fermenting, barm formed on its surface.

definition: in an appropriate manner; fittingly.
example_en: He finished all the work fittingly.

definition: the life of a person.
example_en: His life was full of hardship.

definition: every week.
example_en: This magazine is published every week.

definition: of limited size; of comparatively restricted dimensions; not big; little; small.
example_en: That box was small.

definition: a thin liquid.
example_en: Only thin liquid remained in that vessel.

definition: an assemblage; collection of people or things.
example_en: An assemblage of people had gathered on the ground.

definition: an unmarried woman.
example: ಆ ಊಢೆ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವಂತ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: That unmarried woman lives in her own house.

definition: a very poisonous viper (Vipera russeli) of SE and SC Asia, with a pale-brown body and ringlike black spots edged with white or yellow; russeḷs viper.
example_en: The Russell's viper was hiding in the crop field.

definition: to be clustered into a bunch.
example_en: The bananas hung clustered together in a bunch.

definition: a solemn declaration, made in the name of a god, that one would do or refrain from doing something or pledge oneself to something; a vow.
example: ಅವನು ದೇವರ ಮೇಲೆ ಪಾಳ ಮಾಡಿ ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He made a vow in the name of God and swore that he would not lie.

definition: a piece of torn cloth.
example_en: She wiped the wound with a piece of torn cloth.

definition: to come in lines on either sides.
example: ಮೆರವಣಿಗೆ ನೋಡಲು ಜನರು ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿ ಇಕ್ಕರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: People lined up on both sides of the street to watch the procession.

definition: the 'Khurasān' province, situated in the north east of Iran.
example_en: The traders used to bring horses from the Khurasan province.

definition: a woven fabric; a piece of cloth.
example_en: There was plenty of coloured cloth in the shop.

definition: any bacterial toxin mixed with one's food with the intention of causing sickness; food-poison.
example: ಆಹಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈಮಸಕ ಬೆರೆಸಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They tried to kill him by mixing food-poison into the food.

definition: a freely rotating, magnetised needle, that is horizontal at the magnetic equator (aclinic line) but vertical at the magnetic poles, used to indicate the direction of the earth's magnetism.
example_en: The magnetic inclination compass shows the direction of the earth's magnetism.

definition: a feeling of chagrin at the good fortune, qualities or look etc. of another; envy.
example: ನೆರೆಮನೆಯವರ ಹೊಸ ಕಾರು ಕಂಡು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅಕ್ಕಜ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the neighbor's new car, he felt envy.

definition: the surface of something.
example_en: The surface of the rock was smooth.

definition: the total sum of different or a series of numbers.
example: ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಗ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಖರ್ಚುಗಳ ಒಟ್ಟುಬೇರೀಜು ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: The accountant calculated the total sum of all the expenses.

definition: a stone on which something is inscribed or engraved.
example_en: There was an inscribed stone near the temple.

definition: the quality of being disloyal; disloyalty; faithlessness.
example_en: His disloyalty caused great loss to the kingdom.

definition: a blue-lotus flower.
example_en: The blue lotus had blossomed beautifully in the pond.

definition: to go on; to advance; to proceed; to move forward.
example_en: The army slowly advanced towards the border.

definition: Vaiśya, the caste members of which are chiefly engaged in trade and business.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಭ್ಯ ಜನಾಂಗದವರು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In that town, people of the Vaishya caste carried on trade.

definition: a wicked, depraved man.
example_en: That wicked man helps no one.

definition: a place where goods are sold and bought; a market.
example_en: Prices were low in the fruit market.

definition: evacuation of excrements from the body.
example_en: One must finish the evacuation of excrement as soon as one rises in the morning.

definition: a malleable, magnetic, readily oxidizable metal which is a chemical element of the transition series (atomic no. 26), widely used, chiefly in alloys such as steel, for tools, implements, structures, machinery, etc. (Symbol Fe.); iron.
example_en: The door of the old house was made of iron.

definition: spoiled; damaged; rendered useless.
example_en: The books that got wet in the rain got spoiled.

definition: a kind of spear.
example_en: The warrior walked toward the enemy holding a saraneja spear.

definition: that part of the field of consciousness which at any given moment is outside the range of one's attention; the subconsciousness.
example: ಮನಃಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞರು ಉಪಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ವರ್ತನೆಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Psychologists explain human behavior through the subconsciousness.

definition: to show (to others) one's demerit, deficiency, etc.
example: ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿದವನು ತನ್ನ ಕೋಡಿಗಾಣಿಸಿ ಜನರ ಮುಂದೆ ನಾಚಿದನು.
example_en: The man who had made the mistake showed his deficiency and felt ashamed before the people.

definition: reduced; diminished; shrunk; dwindled.
example: ಮಳೆಗಾಲ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ನದಿಯ ನೀರು ಇಳಿದು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: As the rainy season ended, the river's water was reduced.

definition: a valorous warrior.
example_en: That valorous warrior defeated everyone in the battle.

definition: (pl.) members of the royal court.
example_en: All the members of the royal court gathered around the king.

definition: the annual plant Raphanus sativus of Brassicaceae family; radish plant.
example_en: Radish had grown well in the garden.

definition: to speak; to converse.
example_en: He conversed with his friends for a long time.

definition: a woman who counsels, advises.
example_en: She was renowned as the village's woman counsellor.

definition: the quality or condition of being a ruffian; ruffianism.
example_en: Everyone was fed up with that boy's ruffianism.

definition: to move as a liquid does; to move in a stream, like water; to flow.
example_en: The stream water flows through the valley.

definition: the quality or fact of being low in price or cost; cheapness; inexpensiveness.
example: ಸಸ್ತು ಇದ್ದುದರಿಂದ ಅವನು ಎರಡು ಜೊತೆ ಚಪ್ಪಲಿ ಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: Because of the cheapness, he bought two pairs of sandals.

definition: a golden jar or vase.
example_en: A golden vase was shining in the palace.

definition: a person to whom hospitality is or is to be exended by another; a guest.
example_en: When the guest came, the whole family was happy.

definition: to deform the surface of (something) by pressing, a blow, etc.; to cause to have a dent.
example_en: The metal plate got dented from the blow of the hammer.

definition: the king of a foreign country.
example_en: The envoys of the foreign king came to the city.

definition: a dry cake.
example_en: They packed a dry cake to eat during the journey.

definition: flat ; level; not uneven.
example_en: That land is level and easy to cultivate.

definition: a song sung in chorus; a group song.
example_en: The women sang a chorus song in the field.

definition: a medicine that cures many diseases.
example: ಈ ಬಹುಗ್ರಾಹಿ ಔಷಧ ಹಲವು ರೋಗಗಳನ್ನು ಗುಣಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This many-curing medicine cures many diseases.

definition: any of the oils used to anoint the body with.
example_en: She applied anointing oil to her body before bathing.

definition: (astron.) the circle of the celestial sphere parallel to the celestial equator at c. 230 26' north; the Tropic of Cancer.
example: ಸೂರ್ಯನು ಕರ್ಕವೃತ್ತದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ದಿನ ಉದ್ದವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: When the sun reaches the Tropic of Cancer, the day becomes long.

definition: the sheen or glossiness of black object.
example_en: Her hair had the glossy sheen of black.

definition: (water) to get percolated or evaporated.
example_en: The water in the well percolated into the ground.

definition: an iron or steel block on which metal objects are hammered into shape; an anvil.
example: ಕಮ್ಮಾರ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣವನ್ನು ಅದ್ದನದ ಮೇಲೆ ಇಟ್ಟು ಬಡಿದನು.
example_en: The blacksmith placed the iron on the anvil and hammered it.

definition: originated, made or produced long back.
example_en: This temple is from an old, ancient period.

definition: a yellow cloth.
example_en: Before the worship, he wore a yellow cloth (pītāmbara).

definition: the act or an instance of guarding.
example_en: Those soldiers stood guard the whole night.

definition: something as pickles or other condiments, a small quantity of which is tasted or licked to increase the taste or flavour of the principal food.
example_en: He ate a small taste of pickle along with the rice.

definition: second child (of a woman).
example_en: Her second child is a girl.

definition: a long cloth without any coloured border, esp. worn by widows.
example_en: That widow was wearing a plain, borderless white cloth.

definition: a perfect reckoning or counting.
example_en: The clerk did a perfect reckoning of the accounts carefully.

definition: beyond or without any doubt; certainly; surely.
example_en: It is certainly true that he is honest.

definition: with a red appearance, colour or glow; redly.
example_en: At sunset the sky appeared redly.

definition: an opening in the wall of a house for ventilation; a ventilator.
example: ಅಡುಗೆ ಮನೆಯ ಗೋಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಜಾಳಮಾರ್ಗ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a ventilator in the wall of the kitchen.

definition: a rule ordinance or law by which conduct, etc. is regulated;
example_en: Everyone must behave according to the village's ordinance.

definition: quickness; swiftness.
example: ಅಪಾಯದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಬೆಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಕಾಪಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His quickness during the time of danger saved everyone.

definition: an offering of a kind of cake as an oblation to the mother-earth, as a thanksgiving gesture, while harvesting.
example_en: They offer the cake oblation to mother-earth during harvest time.

definition: a young ox.
example_en: A young ox was grazing in the field.

definition: the teacher of a people.
example_en: They honoured that scholar as a teacher of the people.

definition: a man having no weapons (esp. to defend oneself); an unarmed man.
example: ಆ ನಿರಾಯುಧ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮುಂದೆ ನಿಸ್ಸಹಾಯಕನಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That unarmed man was helpless before the enemies.

definition: that which is auspicious, causes or brings prosperity, welfare, etc.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಗೆ ಸವುಭಾಗ್ಯ ಬಂದಿತು ಎಂದು ಜನರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: People said that auspicious prosperity had come to that house.

definition: intense love.
example: ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಮಗುವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಪಾರ ಅನುರಕ್ತಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The mother had immense intense love for the child.

definition: with; along with.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಕೂಡಣ ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: He went to the town along with his friends.

definition: Indra, Lord of rains.
example: ಮಳೆರಾಯನ ಕೃಪೆಯಿಂದ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: By the grace of Indra, the Lord of rains, the crops have come in well this year.

definition: to cause to be caught, arrested.
example_en: That group caused the thief to be caught.

definition: the plant Flacourtia inermis of Flacourtiaceae family.
example_en: The fruits of the Flacourtia inermis tree are sour.

definition: a body or figure nearly spherical but not quite so; a spheroid.
example_en: The shape of the earth is like a spheroid.

definition: to reflect (an image of an object) 2) to give a form, shape etc. to one's thoughts, schemes, intention, etc.
example_en: The mirror clearly reflected his face.

definition: a painful, grievous feeling caused by jealosy, grief, ditress, etc.
example: ಗೆಳೆಯನ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಕಂಡು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಕಡಿತ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing his friend's success, he felt a pang of jealousy.

definition: the act of trembling, quivering; a throbbing; palpitation.
example_en: A trembling of fear was visible in his hands.

definition: a feudal system binding a person to serve his master as a slave; slavery; servitude; serfdom.
example: ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಸ್ಯಪದ್ಧತಿ ಬಡವರನ್ನು ಬಲಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In earlier times, the system of slavery used to claim the poor as victims.

definition: food, esp. offered to a deity or demon.
example_en: After the worship, food offering was made to the deity.

definition: any ornament for the ankles; an anklet.
example_en: The bride was wearing an anklet.

definition: a long and thin metal or wooden piece fixed from side to side.
example_en: They fixed the crossbar firmly to the door.

definition: any of a family (Hippopotamyidae) of large, plant-eating, artiodactylous mammals with a heavy, thick-skinned, almost hairless body and short legs, living chiefly in or near rivers; hippopotamus.
example_en: The hippopotamus has a large body.

definition: the spike of a cereal plant, bearing grains; the ear of corn.
example_en: The farmers harvested the ear of corn and transported it to the threshing floor.

definition: aggressive forwardness; pertness.
example_en: His aggressive forwardness annoyed everyone.

definition: to set aside, keep apart something for some purpose; to devote (one's wealth, time, etc.) for some purpose.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಆದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮೀಸಲಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He set aside some of his income for education.

definition: to scrap the floor with the toes.
example_en: The child stood scraping the floor with its toes in anger.

definition: a man of noble descent.
example_en: That man of noble descent had gained respect in the village.

definition: a tax or duty imposed by the government on sale, manufacgture, import, export etc.
example_en: Traders had to pay tax on their goods.

definition: of similar kind, type; similar or comparable in all or most of the respects or resembling exactly (another).
example_en: Her face closely resembles her mother's.

definition: the words that give comfort and make feel the other at home; courteous words; polite speech.
example_en: He welcomed the guests with polite, comforting words.

definition: a progressive infectious disease caused by a bacterium (Mycobacterium leprae) that attacks and consumes the skin, flesh, nerves, etc.
example: ಉದುಂಬರಕುಷ್ಠದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಚರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ನರಗಳು ಹಾಳಾದವು.
example_en: Leprosy damaged his skin and nerves.

definition: a disease of the lever.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಆತನಿಗೆ ಅಡ್ಡಗೈ ಎಂಬ ಲಿವರ್ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಇರುವುದಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor told him that he had the liver disease called addagai.

definition: a disease marked by morbid and excessive discharge of urine; diabetes.
example_en: That patient has contracted the disease of excessive urination.

definition: (in comp. only) below; beneath.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರದೇಶವು ಸಮುದ್ರ ಮಟ್ಟಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಿೞ್ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That region is below sea level.

definition: the system or a body of governing a state or country; government.
example_en: The government announced a new scheme.

definition: a wooden bolt, pin or bar for fastening a door; a latch.
example_en: They fastened the door with a latch and secured it from inside.

definition: a flat, wide, plate made intertwining thin bamboo splits.
example_en: She spread the papads on the bamboo plate.

definition: a term used in beseeching, imploring.
example_en: Even though they begged him with pleas, he did not listen.

definition: a tablet calcined in a bottle.
example_en: The physician gave the patient a tablet calcined in a bottle.

definition: a smile expressing or caused by genuine affection, friendliness.
example_en: The grandmother gave an affectionate smile when she saw her grandson.

definition: a soldier equipped with a rifle.
example_en: Rifle-armed soldiers were standing guard at the border.

definition: a man who habitually lies; a lier.
example_en: They drove that habitual liar out of the village.

definition: a man who habitually takes money on loan from others.
example: ಆ ಸಾಲವಣಿಗ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳೂ ಬಡ್ಡಿಗೆ ಹಣ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That habitual borrower used to take money on interest every month.

definition: the act of constructing; construction.
example: ಈ ಸೇತುವೆಯ ವಿರಚನೆ ಎರಡು ವರ್ಷ ಹಿಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The construction of this bridge took two years.

definition: the soft, white seed hairs filling the seedpods of various shrubby plants (genus Gossypium) of the mallow family originally native to the tropics; cotton.
example_en: Cotton is very important for the textile industry.

definition: the act of inlaying in or fusing, soldering, etc. with, another.
example: ಚಿನ್ನದ ಕೀರಣಿಗೆಲಸವು ಆ ಆಭರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಳಪು ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The gold inlay work gave the ornament a shine.

definition: an error of the sight; defective sight.
example_en: He needs spectacles because he has a defective sight.

definition: to prepare a pile of wood, for burning a dead body; to prepare a pyre.
example_en: The villagers went to the forest to prepare the pyre for the dead.

definition: a votive lamp fixed at a place.
example_en: As evening fell, people lit the votive lamp at the spot.

definition: the blood-red colour.
example_en: The evening sky glowed with a blood-red colour.

definition: a good and comfortable house.
example_en: His good and comfortable house is admired by everyone.

definition: suspension -a) a temporary barring from an office, school, etc., b) a temporary stoppage of payment, service, etc., c) a temporary cancelling, as of rules, d) a deferring of action on a sentence, e) a holding back of a judgment, etc.
example_en: The school administration imposed suspension on him.

definition: a passerine bird Montacilla alba of Motacillidae family, having a long wing feathers and a very long tail that wags up and down; a variety of wagtail.
example_en: The wagtail was moving its tail up and down.

definition: any form of wealth employed or capable of being employed in the production of more wealth; capital.
example_en: The bank loan increased the capital.

definition: a hole or hollow place.
example_en: The cart got stuck in the hollow on the road.

definition: amounting to six.
example_en: He had six goats.

definition: the state or fact of being an owner; ownership.
example: ಈ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಆಮ್ಮು ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಹಿರಿಯರಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ.
example_en: The ownership of this land belongs to the village elders.

definition: an act or instance of digressing; a wandering from the main subject in talking or writing; digression.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಪ್ರಸ್ತುತಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿದ್ದರಿಂದ ಯಾರೂ ಕೇಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because there was too much digression in his speech, no one listened.

definition: sweet, delicately persuasive speech.
example_en: Everyone was charmed on hearing her sweet, persuasive speech.

definition: a very big gathering of people.
example_en: A very big gathering of people had assembled at the fair.

definition: the precious yellow metallic element, highly malleable and ductile, and not subject to oxidation or corrosion (symbol: Au); gold.
example_en: Gold ornaments were being sold in the shop.

definition: a kind of dance by a group of people with fancy costumes.
example_en: The artists performed a colourful group dance at the festival.

definition: untimely (raining) cloud.
example_en: Even though the untimely cloud came, it did not rain.

definition: a shallow, oblong tray for holding composed type before it is put into a form; a galley.
example_en: The printer placed the composed letters in the galley.

definition: the thistle plant Argemone mexicana of Papaveraceae family; gamboge thistle.
example_en: A thistle plant has grown beside the fence.

definition: a military detachment to protect the rear of a main force or body; rear-guard.
example_en: The army's rear-guard stopped the enemy's attack.

definition: the final, culminating element or event in a series; highest point, as of interest or excitement.
example_en: That festival reached the climax of excitement.

definition: a famous, well-reputed man.
example_en: That doctor is the town's famous, well-reputed man.

definition: a cap having a feather or feathers on it; a feathered cap.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಗರಿಟೋಪಿಯನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That soldier was wearing a feathered cap on his head.

definition: to show a sign, mark etc.
example: ಅವನು ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲೆದೋಱು ಮಾಡಿ ದಾರಿ ತೋರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He showed a sign with his hand and pointed the way.

definition: a disease characterised by discharge of blood corpuscles along with the urine.
example: ರಕ್ತಮೇಹದಿಂದ ಬಳಲುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ರೋಗಿಯನ್ನು ವೈದ್ಯರ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: They took the patient suffering from the disease of blood in the urine to the doctor.

definition: the earth.
example_en: Greenery had spread everywhere upon the earth.

definition: (the hand) to touch (something).
example_en: His hand accidentally touched the wire.

definition: eager and hurried activities esp. by large number of persons thronging at a place; busy haste.
example_en: On the festival day, there was busy haste of thronging people at the temple.

definition: the words of another quoted.
example_en: He used the teacher's quoted words in his essay.

definition: brilliantly burning coal.
example_en: The blacksmith struck the brilliantly burning coal with his hammer.

definition: the quality of being unable to produce offspring; barrenness; sterility.
example_en: Because of the land's barrenness, no crop grew.

definition: a hidden treasure.
example_en: While digging the field, a hidden treasure was found.

definition: a victorious, triumphant woman; a victor; a winner.
example_en: She became the winner in the game competition.

definition: with a sound as made by birds while flapping their wings.
example_en: The bats flew flapping their wings with a fluttering sound.

definition: to make, take a vow, promise by a vow, as to a god or saint; to vow.
example_en: She made a vow to god for her child's health.

definition: to make a cup from the areca sheet.
example_en: He made a cup from the areca sheet.

definition: a possession by a ghost or spirit.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿಗೆ ಗಂಧರ್ವಗ್ರಹ ಬಡಿದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಜನರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: People said that girl was afflicted by a possession of a spirit.

definition: a profesional advisor in matters of law and who pleads or advocates a legal case in courts of law on behalf of his clients; a lawyer; an advocate.
example: ಆ ಲಾಯರು ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನ ಪರವಾಗಿ ವಾದಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: That lawyer argued in court on my behalf.

definition: brilliant or gorgeous appearance, colouring, etc.; magnificence; splendour.
example_en: The brilliance of that jewel attracted onlookers.

definition: an abnormally swollen part of the body; a swelling.
example_en: A large swelling is rising on his leg.

definition: the evergreen tree Santalum album ( = Sirium myrtifolium) of Santalaceae family.
example: ಗುಡಿಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಬಾವನ್ನ ಮರವೊಂದು ಪರಿಮಳ ಸೂಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A sandalwood tree in front of the temple was spreading fragrance.

definition: hastily; hurriedly.
example: ಬೆಂಕಿ ಕಂಡ ಕೂಡಲೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಧುಳಧುಳನೆ ಹೊರಗೆ ಬಂದರು.
example_en: As soon as they saw the fire, everyone came outside hurriedly.

definition: a kind of powder for blackening the teeth.
example_en: The elder women were applying the blackening powder to their teeth.

definition: to face bravely; to confront boldly.
example_en: He is a brave man who faces any difficulty boldly.

definition: (dial.) an aquatic cereal grass (Oryza sativa) grown widely in warm climates, and its starchy seeds or grains; rice; paddy.
example_en: In that village, rice is grown extensively.

definition: the fact or condition of being present; attendance at some place or in something; presence.
example_en: Everyone's presence was mandatory at the meeting.

definition: an acute, highly contagious virus disease characterised by prolonged fever, vomiting, and pustular eruptions that often leave pitted scars or pockmarks, when healed; a kind of small-pox.
example_en: The small-pox disease spread in that village.

definition: emotional pain or agony.
example_en: The mother who lost her child could not bear the emotional agony.

definition: a woman who takes care of another's child or children, as her own; a mother-like woman.
example: ಅನಾಥ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಆಕೆ ಧಾತ್ರಿಯಾಗಿ ಆರೈಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She took care of the orphan child like a mother.

definition: the waste discharge by the body through the nose, eyes and ears; the dried mucus.
example_en: Dried mucus had formed in the child's nose.

definition: an unfeeling, pitiless cruel man.
example_en: That pitiless man did not help the poor.

definition: a single meaning.
example_en: This word has only a single meaning.
